verdict.rationale: A live probe found a first-party llms.txt served at legalzoom.com/llms.txt, titled as guidance for AI crawlers. A user can therefore point an agent directly at it. The probe shows only the file's header, so how much of the product it covers and how agent-useful it is cannot be checked. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content depth and structure, additional agent-oriented docs (e.g., markdown or API docs for agents), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
